information:
If you are a first-time competitor, the [Registration Process and FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingByTheKings2023#30498-registration-process-and-faq) tab has useful information how the competition will look. All competitiors must read the [Competitior Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingByTheKings2023#30499-competitor-information-must-read) tab before registering.

You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook group: [Ohio and Michigan Speedcubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1655301714974534/)
